ns2:course.label: Surface Hydrology
ns2:course.description: Descriptive and quantitative hydrology dealing with the distribution, circulation, and storage of water on the earth's surface; principles of hydrologic processes; methods of analysis and their applications to engineering and environmental problems. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CEE 350.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: CEE 350.
